 FORECAST: Sunny and warmer Wednesday 
 By Tawana Andrew Published : Nov. 15, 2026 at 4:13 PM EST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WEATHER HEADLINES 
 NEXT 12: Sunny with highs in the 60s 
 SHORT TERM: Highs in the upper 60s to end of the week 
 LONG TERM: Rain chances return by Sunday 
 LATEST FORECAST 
 LOUISVILLE, Ky. (WDRB+WAVE) — Today will be another sunny day as highs rebound into the low to mid-60s. Expect mostly clear skies and very light winds tonight, with temperatures falling quickly after sunset. Lows will settle into the mid-30s in the Louisville Metro, with colder temperatures and patchy frost outside the city. 
 Our warming trend continues on Thursday. Highs soar into the mid-to-upper 60s with plenty of sunshine and a light southerly wind. Despite clear skies and light winds Thursday night, we won’t be as cold as previous nights. Look for lows in the 30s and low 40s. 
 The warmth lasts into Saturday before rain comes our way with a cold front Saturday night into Sunday.
